Tower Lead Record to Report
description:
**Role:** 
 Tower Lead Record To Report (RTR)
 



**Skill:** 
 Finance and Accounts
 



**Experience:** 
 8\-10 Years
 



**Location:** 
 TCS Kolkata
 



**Shift:** 
 Aus/NZ
 



  





**Education:** 




 • Minimum 15 years of regular, full\-time education (10 \+ 2 \+ 3\)
 



 • Non\-technical graduation and/or masters in finance \& accounts stream \- B.Com, M.Com or CA Complete preferred
 



 • Bachelor's/Master's in Finance \& Accounting or equivalent with ERP certification / proficient
 



  





**Must Have Skills:** 




 • Lean Six Sigma certified or formally trained (Black Belt preferred)
 



 • Finance and Accounting domain experience
 



 • Proven track record of leading and/or mentoring multiple Lean Six Sigma improvement projects
 



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills:** 




 • Continuous Improvement / Lean \& Six Sigma
 



 • Stakeholders Coordination
 



 • ERP Exposure (Blackline)
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 This role leads and directs the works of others and overall processes and reviews deliverables. This role requires several years of experience in the field or in a related area. Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures \- relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





 1\.
 **Ownership of the Tower** 




 • Act as the end\-to\-end owner of a specific service tower (e.g., Infrastructure, Applications, Network).
 



 • Ensure overall performance, delivery, and stability of services within the tower.
 



 • Define strategy, roadmap, and improvements for the domain.
 



  





 2\.
 **Service Delivery Management** 




 • Ensure consistent and high\-quality service delivery aligned with SLAs/OLAs.
 



 • Monitor:
 



 • Availability
 



 • Performance
 



 • Incident resolution
 



 • Drive service excellence and customer satisfaction.
 



  





 3\.
 **Team Leadership \& Management** 




 • Lead and manage teams.
 



 • Assign work, track performance, and develop talent.
 



 • Foster collaboration across towers and teams.
 



  





 4\.
 **Incident, Problem \& Change Management** 




 • Oversee:
 



 o Major incident resolution
 



 o Root cause analysis (RCA)
 



 • Problem management initiatives
 



 • Approve and govern changes within the tower.
 



 • Ensure minimal business impact during outages.
 



  





 5\.
 **Stakeholder Management** 




 • Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders (clients, business units, leadership).
 



 • Conduct:
 



 o Business reviews
 



 o Performance reporting
 



 • Manage expectations and communicate risks/issues proactively.
 



  





 6\.
 **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** 




 • Identify opportunities for:
 



 o Automation
 



 o Cost optimization
 



 o Process improvements
 



 • Drive adoption of New tools/technologies
 



  





 7\.
 **Governance \& Compliance** 




 • Ensure compliance with:
 



 o Organizational policies
 



 o Security standards
 



 o Regulatory requirements
 



 • Maintain audit readiness and documentation.
 



  





 8\.
 **Financial \& Resource Management** 




 • Manage:
 



 o Budget and costs for the tower
 



 o Resource allocation and utilization
 



 • Optimize cost vs performance.
 



  





 9\.
 **Risk \& Issue Management** 




 • Identify risks and dependencies.
 



 • Implement mitigation strategies.
 



 • Escalate critical risks to leadership when needed.
 



  





 10\.
 **Collaboration Across Towers** 




 • Work with other Tower Leaders to ensure:
 



 o End\-to\-end service integration
 



 o Seamless cross\-domain operations
 



 o Resolve interdependencies and conflicts
 



  





**Technical Capabilities / Skills:** 




  





**Systems:** 




 • Expert knowledge of SAP or JD Edwards and Blackline
 



 • Proficient in the following systems: MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
 



  





**Soft skills:** 




 • Shows genuine empathy to customers experiencing connection difficulties.
 



 • Able to communicate effectively across a group with diverse backgrounds.
 



 • High energy, self\-motivation with a high degree of accountability
 



  





**Analytical skills:** 




 • High analytical skills with Lean Six Sigma certification
 



  





**Organisational skills:** 




  





 • Time management
 



 • Documentation and knowledge sharing.
 



 • High level written communication skills to interact with key stakeholders
 



  





**Business acumen:** 




  





 RTR Experience of 8\-10 Years in RTR including leadership, people management, process and transition experience of 7\+ years
 



  





**Other Requirements:** 




  





 • Should possess positive attitude to support the business.
 



 • 5 days’ work from office is mandatory including one weekend during Month\-end Close cycle

title: GENERAL MANAGER – HOSPITAL OPERATIONS & GROWTH
description:
**WE ARE HIRING \| GENERAL MANAGER – HOSPITAL OPERATIONS \& GROWTH** 




 📍
 **Lotus Hospital \| Rajarhat, Kolkata** 




 🏥
 **75\-Bed Multispecialty Hospital** 




  





 Lotus Hospital is looking for an experienced and hands\-on healthcare professional to lead its
 **day\-to\-day operations and business growth** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can take ownership, build strong teams, improve operational efficiency and help take the hospital to its
 **next stage of growth and profitability** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Manage end\-to\-end day\-to\-day hospital operations
 



 • Drive OPD, IPD, occupancy and overall revenue growth
 



 • Improve OT, diagnostics and other service utilisation
 



 • Develop and strengthen the doctor/consultant network
 



 • Build referral, corporate, TPA and institutional business
 



 • Improve patient experience and service quality
 



 • Lead and coordinate hospital teams across functions
 



 • Monitor costs, collections, productivity and operational efficiency
 



 • Track MIS, revenue and key business performance indicators
 



 • Work closely with the promoters on growth strategy and execution
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 ✓ 10\+ years of relevant Hospital/Healthcare experience preferred
 



 ✓ Experience in hospital operations and business growth
 



 ✓ Leadership experience in a multispecialty hospital preferred
 



 ✓ Strong understanding of OPD, IPD, doctor management and hospital revenue
 



 ✓ Commercial mindset with strong people\-management skills
 



 ✓ Kolkata/West Bengal healthcare network will be an advantage
 



 ✓
 **Fluency in Bengali is mandatory** 




  





**Preferred Current Profiles:** 




 Hospital Administrator \| Senior Operations Manager \| GM Operations \| Unit Operations Head \| Business Head \| Senior Hospital Management Professional
 



 We are looking for someone who wants to
 **build, grow and take ownership** 
 , rather than simply manage routine administration.
 



 For the right performer, this role offers
 **significant leadership growth and career progression as the hospital scales.** 




  





 📩
 **Interested candidates may send their profile to:** 




 hr@easytechitsolutions.com
 



 Referrals from the healthcare community are welcome.

title: Store Manager - Airtel - Kolkata
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Store Manager
   

  

 Company Name: Airtel
   

  

 Location: Kolkata
   

  

 Salary: 3\-4 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Business or related field
   

  

**Job Description**
 Airtel is looking for an experienced and dynamic Store Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka. As a Store Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, managing a team, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience. If you have a passion for sales, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record in retail management, we want you on board!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Oversee day\-to\-day store operations
   

  

 Manage and lead a team of sales associates
   

  

 Ensure excellent customer service and satisfaction
   

  

 Achieve and exceed sales targets
   

  

 Monitor inventory and manage stock levels
   

  

 Implement marketing and promotional activities
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field
   

  

 3\-5 years of experience in retail management
   

  

 Strong leadership and communication skills
   

  

 Proven track record in achieving sales targets
   

  

 Why Join Airtel?
   

  

 Competitive salary and benefits
   

  

 Opportunities for career advancement
   

  

 Work with a leading telecommunications company
   

  

 Positive and collaborative work environment
   

  

**FAQs**
 Q: What qualifications are required for the Store Manager position?
   

  

 A: A bachelor's degree in Business or a related field is required.
   

  

 Q: How many years of experience are needed for this role?
   

  

 A: The position is open to individuals with 3\-5 years of experience in retail management.
   

  

 Q: What is the salary range for the Store Manager position?
   

  

 A: The salary for the Store Manager role is 3\-4 Lacs P.A. and will be discussed during the interview process.
   

  

 Q: Why join Airtel?
   

  

 A: Airtel offers a competitive salary and benefits, opportunities for career advancement, and a positive work environment within a leading telecommunications company.

 • Stakeholders Coordination
 



 • ERP Exposure (Blackline)
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 This role is responsible for executing more complex processes and exception transactions that involve greater subjective thinking \& analytical ability (or processing a much higher volume of complex transactions). Should have at least 3 years of relevant work experience as Subject Matter Expert in similar complex transaction and processes and at least 2 years in supervising activities with excellent communication, organizational, interpersonal skills along with proficiency in MS Excel \& Powerpoint. Should have expert level knowledge of ERP (preferably SAP or JDE), experience in reporting \& compliance, capable of handling stringent timelines, interacting and preparing analytics and presenting during governance calls with the stakeholders
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




 • Should be able to perform more complex processes and exception transactions that involve greater subjective thinking \& analytical ability (or processing a much higher volume of complex transactions) including ability to research open items and drive to closure
 



 • Complete activities as per customer statement of work
 



 • Meet Targets of TAT and Accuracy
 



 • Be self\-reliant to undertake and complete assigned work
 



 • Undertake self assessment to verify activities done timely and accurately
 



 • Perform Quality check of Sr. Associates \& Subject Matter experts and give feedback
 



 • Evaluate Internal control gaps, have governance with both external and internal stakeholders for risk mitigation
 



 • Identify areas of potential errors and to find ways to fix and avoid errors and repeat issues
 



 • Act as Buddy to new joiners and other Sr. Associates requiring support to perform activities
 



 • Report out hourly \& EOD status of activities performed
 



 • Provide daily update to customer on progress and have interaction emails \& calls
 



 • Prepare \& provide report out in form of dashboards using Excel and PowerPoint
 



 • Identify process gaps and provide controls to mitigate and monitor closure
 



 • Identify process improvement opportunities and take up improvement projects for both self and team and drive to closure
 



 • Operate from Office as standard requirement
 



 • Should not take any unscheduled leaves without pre\-consent from Team Lead
 



 • Be open to operate extended hours to finish deliverable from Office and incase of errors and backlogs and during month\-end, quarter\-end close
 



  





  





**Technical Capabilities / Skills:** 




  





**Systems:** 




  





 • Expert knowledge of SAP or JD Edwards
 



 • Good level of proficiency in the following systems: MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
 



 • Has expert level experience in Excel using IF, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, PIVOT, CELL REFERENCE, AVERAGE, AGEING, DATE FORMAT, TEXT to TABLE
 



 • Has expert level knowledge of preparing Power point
 



  





**Soft skills:** 




  





 • Shows genuine empathy to customers experiencing connection difficulties.
 



 • Able to communicate effectively across a group with diverse backgrounds.
 



 • High energy, self\-motivation with a high degree of accountability
 



  





**Analytical skills:** 




 • High analytical skills with Lean Six Sigma certification
 



  





**Organisational skills:** 




  





 • Time management
 



 • Documentation and knowledge sharing.
 



 • High level written communication skills to interact with key stakeholders
 



  





**Business acumen:** 




  





 8\-10 years of experience in Procure to Pay of which at least 3 years of relevant work experience as Subject Matter Expert in similar complex transaction and processes and at least 2 years in supervising activities with excellent communication, organizational, interpersonal skills along with proficiency in MS Excel \& Powerpoint. Should have expert level knowledge of ERP (preferably SAP or JDE), experience in reporting \& compliance, capable of handling stringent timelines, interacting and preparing analytics and presenting during governance calls with the stakeholders
